articles.summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust (NYSE: PEB) (the Company or Pebblebrook) announced today that on October 8, 2026, it completed the sale of The Hotel Zags, a 174-room hotel in Portland, Oregon, for $10.0 million to a third party. For the trailing twelve months ended August 31, 2026, the hotels estimated net operating loss was ($0.8) million, after an assumed annual capital reserve of 4.0% of total hotel revenues, and its estimated hotel earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) was ($0.6) million. Pebblebrook expects to use the sale proceeds for general corporate purposes, including opportunistically repurchasing the Companys common or preferred shares and supporting other capital allocation priorities intended to enhance long-term shareholder value. articles.summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust (NYSE: PEB) (the Company or Pebblebrook) today announced that Bill Bayless joined its Board of Trustees effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Bayless is the Chief Executive Officer of Maslow Campus Communities and a widely recognized real estate operator with extensive capital markets experience who helped build and institutionalize the modern student housing sector. Over his more than 35-year career, he has been involved in nearly $30 billion in real estate transactions. He co-founded American Campus Communities (formerly NYSE: ACC), a REIT, and led its growth from an early-stage platform into the first publicly traded student housing company. In 2022, he helped lead the companys approximately $13 billion sale to Blackstone. articles.title: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust Welcomes Bill Bayless to Board of Trustees
